angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 897,453 km at 1077.22 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 0.9283 +/- 0.0156 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 1077.22 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.29 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Bonomo et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract): 897,453 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.15 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Bonomo et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5750 +/- 100 K from Bonomo et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bonomo et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-41 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-41.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.278, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-41 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 V, from Bonomo et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-41: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-41 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.38 dex, from Bonomo et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-41 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.26161, from Gajdoš et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019RAA....19...41G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-41 (pscomppars): age 4.4 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-41 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...575A..85B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
